Ana Ghadeeri Jism o Jaan Ghadeeri Hai Imran Abbas.

1
Khuda Ka Shukar Mera Jism-o-Jaan Ghadeeri Hai.
Meri Namaz Ghadeeri Aazaan Ghadeeri Hai.
Faroh, Usool Ke Jhagrey Ka Faisla Hai Ghadeer.
Ali Ko Chorne Wala Kahan Ghadeeri Hai.
Ali Ka Ishq Jhalakta Hai Pak Naslon Mein.
Hai Beta Iss Liye Acha Keh Maa Ghadeeri Hai.

2
Ba Faiz e Hazrat-e-Meesum Karam Howa Mujh Par.
Mizaj Apna Ghadeeri Zabaan Ghadeeri Hai.
Alam Ka Panja Gawahi Yeh De Raha Hai Suno.
Makeen Ghadeeri Hai Iss Ka Makaan Ghadeeri Hai.
Ali Ka Ishq Hi Karta Hai Faisla Sadiq.
Falaan Ghadeeri Nahi Hai Falaan Ghadeeri Hai.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from textwrap import dedent
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ana-ghadeeri-jism-o-jaan-ghadeeri-hai-imran-abbas-tajpoints-48b59b566d17f5b45ae9.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = dedent(metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]).strip()
for lyrics, labels in [(roman, ('1', '2')), (body.strip(), ('۱', '۲'))]:
    opening, first, second = [block.splitlines() for block in lyrics.split('\\n\\n')]
    assert len(opening) == 1
    assert [(stanza[0], len(stanza[1:])) for stanza in (first, second)] == [(label, 6) for label in labels]
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Verified the preamble and two six-verse stanzas in both editions.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body in the selected lyric and moved the Roman wording into `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions contain the preamble and two six-verse stanzas in the same order. Set the title in Urdu, retained the Roman alternate title, switched the direction to RTL, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Faroh” as فروع because it is paired with اصول, and rendered “Meesum” as میثم.
